appliesTo: Orbit Home all current and future windows
implementationStatus: specification; not proof of expanded views in runtime
notes: Any new widget must be added to this manifest before release. Passing manifest coverage does not prove functionality; Playwright content-delta tests are required.

widgets.title: Up next
widgets.expanded: chronological upcoming events over 7 days, dates, open-event and Planner actions
widgets.assertion: upcoming future event details and navigation
widgets.privacy: Use existing Orbit state; no invented remote or copied personal records.

widgets.title: Today's priorities
widgets.expanded: all incomplete tasks with due/priority metadata, completion, creation and useful filters
widgets.assertion: more than three incomplete tasks are available, not duplicated
widgets.privacy: Use existing Orbit state; no invented remote or copied personal records.

widgets.title: Focus session
widgets.expanded: timer, all real durations, reset, active sound preset, focus status and controls
widgets.assertion: focus controls and sound settings visible
widgets.privacy: Use existing Orbit state; no invented remote or copied personal records.

widgets.title: Spotify
widgets.compact: connection or live track and playback
widgets.expanded: real track metadata, album, progress, device, permitted playback controls and open Spotify
widgets.assertion: more genuine playback details without fabricated records
widgets.privacy: Use existing Orbit state; no invented remote or copied personal records.

widgets.title: Weather · 5 days
widgets.expanded: seven-day forecast, precipitation, location/unit controls, retry and attribution
widgets.assertion: seven real forecast days from same weather response
widgets.privacy: Use existing Orbit state; no invented remote or copied personal records.

widgets.title: Email
widgets.compact: three messages and current connection state
widgets.expanded: up to thirty messages, important/all filters, sender/subject/time, open message and Inbox
widgets.assertion: more messages and working filters using existing mail state
widgets.privacy: Use existing Orbit state; no invented remote or copied personal records.

widgets.title: Continue watching
widgets.expanded: multiple in-progress and queued items with progress and resume actions and Media Center link
widgets.assertion: two or more valid resumable items if data exists
widgets.privacy: Use existing Orbit state; no invented remote or copied personal records.

widgets.title: Quick notes
widgets.expanded: large full editor, note-related controls and size/count feedback without duplicate storage
widgets.assertion: same note remains editable after restore and refresh
widgets.privacy: Use existing Orbit state; no invented remote or copied personal records.

widgets.title: Calendar
widgets.compact: one week of seven date cells and four selected-day events
widgets.expanded: at least fourteen selectable date cells and multiday agenda with navigation
widgets.assertion: more than seven dates and multi-day events, when present
widgets.privacy: Use existing Orbit state; no invented remote or copied personal records.

widgets.title: Ambient sound
widgets.compact: active preset selection and sound state
widgets.expanded: all supported presets, status, controls linked to running Focus and genuine audio settings
widgets.assertion: more functional settings without fictional mixer controls
widgets.privacy: Use existing Orbit state; no invented remote or copied personal records.

widgets.title: Recent files
widgets.expanded: up to thirty connected files with type, modified metadata, open action and Files link
widgets.assertion: more than four real file records when available
widgets.privacy: Use existing Orbit state; no invented remote or copied personal records.
